en: Theragāthā 3.10 Tikanipāta, Paṭhamavagga (First Chapter) The Elder Sāriputta I have seen the Buddha, the Great Hero, The Teacher who has crossed over the flood; Having heard his Dhamma, which leads to peace, I have attained the state of peace myself. I am free from all suffering, My mind is well-liberated; Having reached the goal, I dwell at ease, Cool and serene within. I have no more birth, The holy life has been lived, What was to be done has been done, There is nothing further to be done. I am a sage (muni), A disciple of the One with Vision; I am one who has reached the end, One who has crossed over the flood.
